title: Lights, Camera, Engagement: How Video is Transforming Events
summary: Video isn’t just for marketing anymore as it’s becoming the engine behind sponsorship revenue, stakeholder engagement and year-round content strategy for event professionals. But are you using it to its full potential? Our industry experts explain what most organizations are getting wrong with video, how to make high-quality production accessible on any budget, and why the right video-first strategy could be the key to unlocking sponsorship revenue you didn’t know you were leaving behind. The post Lights, Camera, Engagement: How Video is Transforming Events appeared first on IAEE .

title: Matthew Kalb is Transforming Events Education Through Authenticity and Innovation
summary: What separates educators who inform from those who transform careers? In this candid conversation, Bob Dallmeyer Educator of the Year Matthew Kalb reveals why he believes that real learning happens when educators lead with curiosity and shares his mentorship approach that positions his students as industry leaders. Get his insider perspective on events education today and the mindset shift that's helping his mentees accelerate their path to industry recognition. The post Matthew Kalb is Transforming Events Education Through Authenticity and Innovation appeared first on IAEE .

title: One Voice. One Industry. One Day.
summary: Your industry is being shaped by decisions made in Washington – on trade, travel, taxes and the workforce – and the window to influence those decisions is now. title: The Heartbeat of the Show Floor
summary: The show floor is alive and the technology powering it is evolving fast.
